- title: "UI Design System"
  slug: ui-design-system
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    Port imgen's design token architecture into kspec's Tailwind-based web UI.
    Map oklch color tokens, spacing, radii, z-index, typography, and animation
    keyframes as Tailwind theme extensions. Establish consistent visual language
    across all views.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        The web UI app.css file
      when: |
        imgen token-contract.css values are mapped as Tailwind @theme inline extensions
      then: |
        All 16 color tokens, 4 radii, 7 spacing, 7 z-index, and 3 font families
        are available as Tailwind utility classes (e.g. bg-design-surface, border-design-border)
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        A component using design tokens
      when: |
        The dark theme tokens are applied
      then: |
        oklch colors render correctly and status colors (pending=amber, in_progress=orange,
        pending_review=blue, needs_work=yellow, completed=emerald, blocked=red, cancelled=gray)
        are visually distinct
    - id: ac-3
      given: |
        A view with loading states
      when: |
        Content is loading
      then: |
        Shimmer animation plays on skeleton elements, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion
    - id: ac-4

    - id: ac-2

        A task card on the board

        The card renders

        It shows priority badge, tag chips, title, slug (mono), spec ref link,

        A task card
